title: The Legend of Zelda: Oracle of Seasons
shortDescription: A brisk Zelda adventure built around seasonal change, combat-focused challenges, and a world that transforms with the calendar.
highlights: Season changes alter routes, puzzles, and the timing of exploration
A more action-forward structure complements the companion Oracle adventure

signals.label: GameAtlas editorial selection
signals.rationale: A complementary Game Boy Color selection whose seasonal world state gives a small-screen adventure a strong organizing idea.
